title: Figma Plugin Phase 4 - Missing Generator Coverage
overview: Add Figma generators for the 3 components currently excluded from drift detection: Breadcrumbs, Empty, PageHeader. Field is permanently excluded as a utility wrapper with no visual representation.

context.problem: 3 components in component-registry.json don't have Figma generators and are temporarily excluded in drift-detection.test.ts. This creates gaps in the Figma UI kit.
context.current_state: 26/30 registry components have generators. 4 are permanently excluded (DropdownMenu, Field, Icon, Toasty) as aliases/utilities. 3 need generators: Breadcrumbs, Empty, PageHeader.
context.why_now: Phase 3 (parser enhancements + test brittleness fixes) is COMPLETE. Next logical step is achieving full visual component coverage.

primary: Remove completed components from EXCLUDED_COMPONENTS in drift-detection.test.ts
metrics: Drift detection test validates all non-utility components
All new generators have rigorous tests with snapshots
